Translation: of good name, euph. for left
to turn about, to reverence, to put to shame, respect
pertaining to the law; one skilled in the Mosaic law, a lawyer
to superabound, to make to abound
that which is lacking, need, want
in favor of, for the pleasure of
to make to grow, to nourish, feed
to contend for a prize, struggle

1. Have dealings or negotiate with
2.  of an oracle, give a response (NT: Divine instructions or warnings)
